predictor.notes: Best-effort predictor, not an identified exact pricing rule. Observed exact totals were 28,360 cents at quantity 10; 141,800 at 50; 567,200 at 200; and 762,000 at 1000. Estimate and alias agreed at all four catalogue quantities and reported no rounding. Tested non-catalogue estimates and aliases were denied, including in session 2; all tested approved requests were unavailable. The model matches every observed price, extends the observed 2,836-cents-per-unit relationship through quantity 200, and linearly interpolates from 200 to 1000. The breakpoint at 201 is a modelling choice, not an observed pricing boundary. Unobserved quantities remain uncertain: hidden curves, discounts or discontinuities cannot be determined from these observations. Used 22 business requests and 5 REA operations, including inspection.
